title: Ai trading bot suggestion
author: FixBackground1718
selftext:
Hi I am looking for an AI bot to start exploring. Any recommendations?

Complete beginner here wrt AI bot - but I am a AI engineer so I do have a deeper understanding. 

I haven't traded before but I'm curious to dip my toes in and see what's out there. I know there are a lot of crypto bots around, but I'm also open to share market / stock trading — not set on either.

Just looking to explore a bit and learn as I go. Would love to hear:

\- What platforms are beginner-friendly and actually legit?

\- Is crypto or stocks easier to start with when using a bot?

\- Anything I should watch out for as a total newbie?

Thanks in advance!

comments.author: medialantern
comments.body:
I mean, with all respect, the thing you should watch out for is when people say "AI" today they're almost exclusively talking about large language models. You're not going to find folks *legitimately* making money solely by asking a non-deterministic, stochastic algorithm whose weights were generated by scraping Reddit posts and "destructively scanning" books. There's an old day trader's rule that people with truly good algorithms never share them, and if a person is sharing one, it isn't any good.

Again, with respect, it's confusing that you would claim to be an AI engineer and still think this is possible. Unless you're working a news/sentiment type of angle, or planning to work more from the ML/neural-net angle (which is not what people mean by "AI bot" today), this is almost by definition not what these things are good at.
